name: ddd-boundary-policing
description: Architectural policing for DDD bounded contexts in a NestJS modular monolith
author: Victor Gabriel Marques

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.arch:graph: depcruise src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --include-only "^src/" --exclude "\\.spec\\.ts$" --output-type mermaid --output-to docs/grafo-de-dependencias.mmd && node scripts/wrap-mermaid.mjs docs/grafo-de-dependencias.mmd docs/grafo-de-dependencias.md
scripts.arch:graph:contexts: depcruise src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --collapse "^src/(modules/[^/]+|contracts|shared-kernel|infrastructure)" --include-only "^src/" --exclude "\\.spec\\.ts$" --output-type mermaid --output-to docs/grafo-de-contextos.mmd && node scripts/wrap-mermaid.mjs docs/grafo-de-contextos.mmd docs/grafo-de-contextos.md
